Amo | Senior Software Engineers (Rust, iOS, Android) | Paris, France | ONSITE | Full-time | Visa Sponsorship

At amo, we are building consumer social apps designed to get people off their phones and into IRL interactions. We work together on-site 5 days a week in Paris. Relocation is fully supported.

We have several open positions on our engineering team, including:

* Backend Software Engineer (Rust): Prior Rust knowledge is optional; looking for deep expertise in distributed systems, scalability, and reliability.

* iOS Software Engineer (Swift)

* Android Software Engineer (Kotlin)

* and more

Check out all of our open positions and apply here

https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/amo?utm_source=Rdm7gEVjvO

Also if you have any questions about the team, product, relocation process feel free to get in touch directly with me via https://www.linkedin.com/in/morenol/
